create_renderer: create a MuJoCo Renderer instance with model, height, width, and font scale settings
render_scene: render the MuJoCo scene as a numpy array of pixel values with optional output buffer
update_scene: update the rendering scene with MjData, camera ID or name, and optional scene options
enable_depth_rendering: enable depth rendering mode to output depth values instead of RGB pixels
enable_segmentation_rendering: enable segmentation rendering mode to output object IDs and types per pixel
